purpose: Backend contract for streaming Nanopore upload, incremental Batch processing, report publication, and graceful run termination.

requirements: A completed file must become eligible for processing without waiting for finalize.
The backend must atomically add completed files to the next processing batch.
File registration and completion must remain idempotent.
A file must never be processed more than once unless explicitly retried after failure.
Start or wake one long-lived Batch task after the first completed POD5 file.
Poll for new completed files or manifest generations while the run is open.
Process bounded batches as files become available.
Persist batch IDs, input file IDs, state, timestamps, exit code, and error details.
Do not require a finalized run manifest to process an open run.
Publish a report after each completed processing batch.
Retain all prior batch reports.
Publish reports only after their batch outputs are durable.
Expose report metadata and URLs without exposing storage credentials.
reports.gui_compatibility: The GUI also accepts a single processing.report or status.report object containing report.iterations.

termination.meaning: Stop accepting new files, finish or cancel safely any active batch according to backend policy, signal the Batch VM/task to shut down, and publish the final state.
requirements: Reject or clearly mark files completed after termination begins.
Prevent new batch creation after termination begins.
Drain or explicitly account for the active batch before shutdown.
Persist termination_requested_at and terminated_at timestamps.
Return workflow_state=stopping or complete and processing_status=stopping, submitted, or pending as appropriate.
Make repeated termination requests idempotent.
Return a correlation/request ID on every run, file, batch, and report response.
Include run ID, batch ID, file IDs, and manifest generation in structured logs.
Expose safe error details to the GUI while keeping credentials and SAS URLs out of responses and logs.

backward_compatibility.legacy_finalize_behavior: Streaming runs use the existing finalize endpoint. It freezes new intake, writes the stopping control state, and drains visible generations on the single long-lived Batch task.
backward_compatibility.recommended_versioning: No separate streaming endpoint is required. Keep run_mode=streaming in the run model and preserve the finalize endpoint as the operator shutdown signal.
